title: geofm-landslide-benchmark: cross-model evaluation protocol and derived datasets for geospatial foundation models in landslide susceptibility
description: Reproducibility package for 'What survives an audit: evaluating geospatial foundation models for landslide susceptibility against a geomorphometric baseline' (in preparation for Earth Science Informatics). The code (tag v1.4.0) implements the cross-model benchmark of TerraMind and Prithvi-EO-2.0 against a 17-layer geomorphometric baseline under spatial-block cross-validation, with the random-initialization ablation, point-probe controls (context-matched manual baselines, spectral scar probe, constrained-negative sensitivity), the control arms (ground motion, movement typology, geology, climate), and the audit re-analyses (positional floor on the benchmark folds for every pipeline, range of spatial dependence against the block size, variance of the negative draw and of the block-grid placement, readers tuned by nested spatial cross-validation), together with the table and figure generators and the per-fold result files (JSON) behind every reported number. The deposit adds the derived datasets: 17-layer geomorphometric feature stacks (npz) for five Chilean basins, annual 2023 Sentinel-2 L2A composites (GeoTIFF) built per MGRS tile for Huasco, Maipo and Maule, the sampled benchmark points with spatial-block ids (CSV), the Prithvi input patches of those points (uint16 memmaps) and the Maule fold indices. data/ZENODO_DEPOSIT.md documents every file. The transformer-block sweep, low-rank adaptation, the pre-/post-event test and the Prithvi susceptibility surfaces predate the Prithvi input-offset correction; their result files are kept in the code for traceability but are not reported.
